programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

Life continues as the kids prep for school and their parents shuffle off to work. The young adults of the area are trying to scrape a living for themselves, while the elders sit on their front porches and observe the goings on. The South Side has the potential to crush dreams, and this coming-of-age series focuses on Kevin, a preteen who embraces the normal rites of childhood, Brandon, who makes a leap of faith to succeed in love and life with Jerrika, Emmett, who seeks guidance from his mother, and Ronnie, who is a drifter struggling to be loved. All of them are linked together by sheer coincidence as they seek redemption.

programme.title: The World of Henry Orient
programme.desc: While trying to seduce a married woman (Paula Prentiss), egotistical concert pianist Henry Orient (Peter Sellers) is interrupted by two precocious schoolgirls, Valerie (Tippy Walker) and Marian (Merrie Spaeth). When they arrive, Jerusha befriends the Hawaiian people and embraces their customs and culture, while Abner, intent on converting them to Christianity, views them as pagan savages. Jerusha grows unhappy with her marriage and begins to fall for Rafer Hoxworth (Richard Harris), a past lover.

programme.title: Ace of Aces
programme.desc: A sculptor turns flying-corps ace in World War I France to show his fiancée he's not a coward.

programme.title: Ever in My Heart
programme.desc: Mary Archer (Barbara Stanwyck), a wealthy, small-town girl, falls in love with Hugo Wilbrandt (Otto Kruger), a German who came to town with her ex-boyfriend, Jeff (Ralph Bellamy). Hugo returns Mary's love, becomes a U.S. citizen and starts a family with her. When the United States enters into World War I, however, vicious anti-German sentiment sweeps the country. The couple are shunned by friends, Hugo loses his job simply because he is German and even Mary gets suspicious of her husband.

programme.title: Picture Snatcher
programme.desc: After being released from prison, former gangster Danny Kean (James Cagney) decides to reform, getting a job as a newspaper photographer. He falls for Patricia (Patricia Ellis), but she is the daughter of Lt. Nolan (Robert Emmett O'Connor), a policeman who knows Kean's shady past. When Kean covertly photographs an execution, Nolan gets into trouble, which pits both father and daughter against Kean. He must then use his street smarts to find a big story in order to redeem himself in their eyes.

programme.title: Spitfire
programme.desc: When civil engineer George Fleetwood (Ralph Bellamy) and his partner, John Stafford (Robert Young), arrive in the Ozarks to oversee the construction of a dam, they meet local spitfire Trigger Hicks (Katharine Hepburn). Fiercely independent and versed in the ways of folk medicine, Hicks is suspected of witchcraft and has been cast out by the judgmental residents of the nearby town. When Trigger abducts a baby who has fallen ill, George and John struggle to help the impoverished woman.

programme.title: Fools for Scandal
programme.desc: On a Paris vacation, famous actress Kay Winters (Carole Lombard) -- using a pseudonym -- meets the seemingly penniless but entirely charming Rene Viladel (Fernand Gravey). Viladel spends the day with her, guiding her through the city, but loses her that evening. Determined to be with her, Viladel discovers Winters' true identity, and travels to her house in London. However, he faces a few hurdles and the competition of salesman Phillip Chester (Ralph Bellamy) before he can win her affection.

programme.title: Dive Bomber

To their dismay, Doug enrolls in a pilot training course in order to better study the effects of flying on pilots, and both fliers end up participating in his experiments. Joined by flight surgeon Lance Rogers (Ralph Bellamy), the men sacrifice everything to make the skies safer for military aviators.

programme.title: Delightfully Dangerous

Believing Josephine's fabricated stories, Cheryl is crushed to discover her sister is actually a performer in a bawdy burlesque house. But, when the siblings meet theatrical impresario Arthur Hale (Ralph Bellamy), he promises to make them both stars, and falls for Josephine in the process.

During their stay, the 39-year-old Roosevelt comes down with a fever and sudden paralysis that is eventually diagnosed as polio. With the help of his wife, Eleanor (Greer Garson), and his close friend and political consultant, Louis Howe (Hume Cronyn), FDR battles his newfound disability.
